_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY. The real per-server config lives at ~/.cowork/config.json (override with COWORK_CONFIG). On first run the server copies this file there; edit the copy, not this template. Personal host/agent settings must never be committed here.
_portal_comment: Portal launcher cards moved to portal.json (live: ~/.cowork/portal.json, hot-reloaded). The optional serviceControl.enabled switch for lifecycle buttons stays in this file.
_obsidian_comment: Shared knowledge base every agent can query. Local agents (same host) may read vaultPath off disk directly; remote agents use GET /api/obsidian/* and the obsidian_* MCP tools. Served read-only. The Portal shows an 'Obsidian Vault' web-viewer card when enabled.

orchestration._concurrency_comment: maxConcurrent is the GLOBAL ceiling on locally-spawned runs across all agents. defaultAgentConcurrency is the per-agent fallback cap for agents without their own maxConcurrent. An agent backed by a shared inference server (the local hermes/vLLM agents) or a stateless CLI can set agents.<id>.maxConcurrent > 1 to serve several tasks at once on ONE instance; when a preferred chain rung is saturated the dispatcher load-balances the overflow onto the next local rung with spare capacity, so no single workhorse agent absorbs every task.

verifier._comment: Rejects soft failures that exit 0 (rate-limit/quota/overloaded/empty replies) so they hand over to the next fallback agent instead of being marked done. failPatterns are merged with the built-ins. Enable llm for an extra LLM quality gate that judges genuine task completion.

panel._comment: PS-2 multi-family review panel. enabled=false forces every gate back to one reviewer. Gates opt in with gate.panel (build-and-ship build + final-review use 2). judgmentTier=true also runs the panel+lead in the spec verifier for tier:judgment tasks (off until the eval gate passes).

orchestrator.description: Decompose a CEO idea into role-tagged subtasks and dispatch them

generalist.description: Fallback when the router can't classify or an agent fails through its chain

local-script-eval-harness.description: Eval harness (P2-1) — runs the eval-prompt-change procedure only. Do not route other tasks here.
